title: Mazloom Bhira, Haye Nahi Sir Tay Rida
body:
Nahi Waqaf Shaam Day Rawan Dee (x2) Bin Chadar Haar Mastoor Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Laash Na Einj Chahd Jandee Mei, Teykoun Veeran Kafan Pawandee Mei
Kareen Maaf Khata Chan Veer Mera (x2) Teri Behn Baoun Majboor Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Nahien Mangdee Chadar Apnay Laee, Bus Laash Teri Tay Pa Jawan
Khavan Pathar Mei Sang Bharjaeeyan Day (x2) Mei Koon Veer Ey Gal Manzoor Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Paey Sarhday Khaimay Sayadan Day, Paeeyan Laashan Char Chofayray Nay
Maqtal Day Wich Maqtoolan Noun (x2) Paya Labda Saara Poor Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Na Rown Deyvan Teri Laash Outhay, Teri Dhee Masoom Sakina Noun
Eyn Gaal Dasa Dukhiya Da Bhira (x2) Aey Kis Ja Da Dastoor Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hathkariyan Da Nahien Ghaam Koi, Teri Behn Koun Ey Ghaam Maar Gaya
Sir Nangay Zahra Jaeeyan Day (x2) Sang Abid Puthar Ghayour Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaway Jis Pasay Sir Akbar Da, Shabbir Di Akh Hy Ous Pasay
Thak Thak Shabbir Thay Akbar Noun (x2) Paee Rondi Haar Mastoor Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Haider Di Jaee Wich Maqtal Akhay Ro Ro Kalma Goan Noun
Gal Laan Devo Aik Vaar Mei Koun (x2) Jera Sung Zakhma Day Choor Ey.
